DiveAtlas is an interactive map for exploring dive sites and regions alongside reef extent, coral and fish records, bathymetry, and ocean layers for water temperature, clarity, currents, waves, and tides. The historical monthly Dive Experience Outlook summarizes available physical and ecological data with a score, confidence, and source details. Reef Condition provides historical ocean-heat and reef thermal-stress context. These views use climatologies, models, and mapped records—not live dive reports—and the outlook is not a safety rating.

Waves

i

Monthly regional wave estimates from Copernicus Marine. Significant wave height averages the highest third of waves; individual waves may be higher. Local conditions vary. These data are not real-time and are not suitable for navigation or dive-safety decisions.

Source
Copernicus Marine · WAVERYS · GLOBAL_MULTIYEAR_WAV_001_032
Resolution
0.2° · ~22 km at equator

Dive Experience Outlook

i

Historical monthly estimate of broad dive conditions from available physical and ecological data. It is not a dive-safety rating; actual conditions vary locally and day to day.

Model
7 weighted dimensions; some data may be unavailable at a location.
Grid
0.5° output cells; input datasets have varying native resolutions.
Map colors
Yellow is less favorable; dark purple-blue is more favorable. Opacity reflects evidence quality.
